normative_status: This artifact is an exact scientific-core input to a possible v7 architecture proposal. It is not an interpretation, implementation, execution record, result, approval, ratification, or intake artifact.

scope.purpose: Bind the scientific causal, semantic, estimand, evidence, reporting, receipt, and claim boundaries that a v7 proposal must preserve or add.

functions.THINK: The continuing child's waking thought, action, and public-outcome stream.
functions.DREAM: Disposable management of finite waking context only; DREAM is neither evidence nor persistent memory authority.
functions.SLEEP: Compilation of grounded propositions already authored by the continuing child and writing of the personal LoRA under the fresh-from-birth contract.

organism_boundary.birth_bootstrap_role: A one-time target-blind schooling intervention before parenting; it is neither personal memory nor a recurring cognitive organ.

parent_repetition_boundary.sole_permitted_causal_path: parent_or_repetition -> waking_context -> child_thought -> child_action -> public_outcome -> committed_child_trace -> independent_eligibility -> later_SLEEP
parent_repetition_boundary.child_restatement_rule: A parent-influenced proposition may qualify only when the continuing child independently commits the complete proposition and it independently passes temporal, same-life grounding, semantic, and provenance rules. Parent provenance never substitutes for child provenance or public grounding.
parent_repetition_boundary.repetition_claim_limit: Neither uptake, Delta_F, nor Delta_E identifies the causal benefit of repetition itself without a separate randomized one-exposure-versus-spaced-repetition factor.

primary_birth_levels.meaning: Direct-solution active-control birth trained on the canonical rational action without the declared feedback-to-action computation.
Teachability birth trained to derive the same canonical rational action through exactly one declared general feedback-to-action computation.

parent_levels.meaning: Solo control with no parent process advice and prospectively matched nonparent opportunity.
The same exogenous parent-message schedule and bytes regardless of child history.

M0_diagnostic.meaning: Unmodified frozen base model used only to diagnose pre-existing entry competence and bootstrap damage.

paired_D_T_contract.only_intended_difference: T's response demonstrates exactly one declared general feedback-to-action computation before the canonical action; D receives the same action directly.

target_blindness.definition: Bootstrap construction has no incremental dependency on downstream developmental or evaluation targets beyond knowledge already present in frozen upstream models or demonstrators.

birth_parent_factorial.adaptive_extension: A separately randomized and separately reported birth_{D,T} x parent_{absent,adaptive} extension; it is not pooled with or substituted for the primary absent/fixed factorial.

shared_outcome_contract.Y: Binary engine-recorded task success within the prospectively frozen budget; invalid, missing, or noncrossing observations are zero under the frozen rule.
shared_outcome_contract.evaluation_context: Every downstream exam begins from empty active context, uses a fresh executor, closes its transcript before model-free truth scoring, and has no return edge to the continuing child.

Delta_R.design: Independently assigned disposable same-state clones receive correct, none, irrelevant, or wrong novel process advice.
Delta_R.primary_comparison: The T-versus-D difference in the correct-versus-none advice effect.

Delta_F.personal_SLEEP: Active under the fresh-from-birth full-cumulative-corpus contract in every relevant arm.
Delta_F.fixed_parent: Exogenous identical reminder bytes at child ages 1, 9, 17, and 25, with no history-conditioned timing or content.
Delta_F.allowed_claim_if_powered_evidence_later_: T modifies the total fixed-curriculum-plus-personal-SLEEP regime's entry-normalized developmental performance curve relative to D.
Delta_F.stronger_label_condition: Intrinsic or latent learning-rate language is forbidden unless a later prospectively frozen measurement model distinguishes ceiling, threshold, transfer, persistent entry-policy, corpus, and promotion alternatives.

Delta_E.design: Separately randomized and separately reported birth_{D,T} x parent_{absent,adaptive} experiment under a prospectively frozen adaptive policy and matched nonparent opportunity.
Delta_E.personal_SLEEP: Active under the fresh-from-birth full-cumulative-corpus contract in every relevant arm.
Delta_E.allowed_claim_if_powered_evidence_later_: T modifies the total adaptive-parent-plus-child-plus-personal-SLEEP package's entry-normalized developmental performance curve relative to D.
Delta_E.stronger_label_condition: Intrinsic or latent learning-rate language is forbidden unless a later prospectively frozen measurement model distinguishes ceiling, threshold, transfer, persistent entry-policy, corpus, and promotion alternatives.

estimands.identification_rule: Delta_R, Delta_F, and Delta_E are birth-assignment effect-modification estimands, not mediation decompositions. Treatment-induced thoughts, corpora, gradients, preservation decisions, and promotions remain part of total developmental paths.

matched_solo_resource_opportunity_contra.equality_rule: Every covered absent/fixed/adaptive comparison must consume the exact receipt whose arm, root, resource, opportunity, policy, and covered-action bindings match that invocation.
matched_solo_resource_opportunity_contra.failure_policy: Substitution, omission, expiry, replay outside policy, wrong covered action, or any resource/opportunity inequality fails closed before the affected action.

child_authored_evidence_contract.decision_rule: A clause is admissible if and only if exact child authorship, commit identity, temporal order, same-life public grounding, semantic identity, and provenance all pass under the frozen support-resolver contract. Dispute, missing evidence, or an undecidable case rejects the clause.

required_provenance.child_proposition_ids: Exact IDs resolving to one or more committed propositions authored by this continuing child in this life.
required_provenance.public_support_ids: Exact IDs resolving to this child's committed public action and/or public outcome evidence.
required_provenance.life_id: One exact life identity shared by proposition and support records.
required_provenance.commit_roots: Immutable roots proving the proposition and support records existed before eligibility and compilation.
required_provenance.grounding_rule_id: The prospectively frozen rule identifying why cited public evidence supports the authored proposition.
required_provenance.support_threshold_id: The prospectively frozen threshold applicable to ordinary, corrective, or generalized clauses.
required_provenance.support_resolver_contract_root: The exact FROZEN_SUPPORT_RESOLVER_CONTRACT root used for the decision.

child_authorship.required_event: The child emitted and committed the complete proposition in a waking trace before compiler access.

temporal_order.prospective: For a prior prediction, intention, rationale, or policy, child_authorship_commit < referenced_action_or_outcome.
temporal_order.retrospective_or_corrective: referenced_action_or_outcome < child_authorship_commit < compiler_render, and the clause must remain explicitly retrospective or corrective.
temporal_order.relation_authorship: Chronology cannot create a causal, temporal, comparative, or confidence relation; the relation itself must have been child-authored and grounded.

grounding.allowed_sources: Only the same child's committed public actions and public outcomes.
grounding.outcome_valence: Success, rational failure, or a child-authored correction may support an already-authored proposition under its declared rule; valence alone neither creates nor validates a proposition.

child_authored_evidence_contract.corrective_clause: Eligible only if the child authored the corrected proposition after the cited corrective public evidence and before compilation, and it independently meets the grounding rule.
child_authored_evidence_contract.generalized_clause: Eligible only if the child already authored the generalized proposition at the same semantic scope and its declared threshold was satisfied before compilation.

support_resolver_representation_boundary.delivery: One per-invocation READ capability with an explicit close-and-reissue bridge.
support_resolver_representation_boundary.mechanical_establishment_rule: If the frozen representation and rules cannot mechanically establish the entire clause, eligibility is denied.
support_resolver_representation_boundary.output_bindings: Every eligibility record and support/taint receipt binds the exact resolver-contract root, child proposition IDs, support IDs, life ID, commit roots, temporal classification, semantic-scope representation, threshold ID, and decision.

compiler_semantic_boundary.role: Render eligible grounded child-authored propositions into response-only replay, retrieval, and native-use views without adding cognition.

bidirectional_audit.render_to_source: Every loss-bearing rendered clause is entailed by its cited child-authored proposition without added semantic content.
bidirectional_audit.source_to_render: The cited child-authored proposition is recoverable from the rendered clause without loss of any target-relevant semantic qualification.

fresh_from_birth_constructor_stager_cont.candidate_equation: C_s := W(B_z, Z0_s, E_le_s, K_writer, K_support, K_coverage_dose, seed_s)

constructor.initialization: At every personal SLEEP event, construct on immutable assigned birth B_z with a new personal LoRA whose effective delta is exactly zero before the first update.

fresh_from_birth_constructor_stager_cont.sealed_candidate_transition: Only after candidate bytes and the complete construction trace close may a registered bridge issue staging inputs.

stager.allowed_effect: Stage or reject the already closed candidate.

prior_head_mutation_invariance.intervention: Mutate or substitute the prior active head after cumulative eligible evidence and all constructor inputs are frozen.

fresh_from_birth_constructor_stager_cont.candidate_rejection: Committed life and the prior active child remain intact. Rejected candidate bytes and derivatives never become evidence.
fresh_from_birth_constructor_stager_cont.promotion_boundary: Any later promotion must consume a separately valid preservation verdict and use one atomic full-head compare-and-swap; candidate existence or staging is never activation authority.

cumulative_coverage_dose_overflow_contra.full_coverage_rule: Every proposition in the full cumulative eligible closure receives at least one loss-bearing inclusion at every eligible personal SLEEP event.
cumulative_coverage_dose_overflow_contra.comparison_rule: Replay, rank, absent/fixed/adaptive opportunity, and cadence comparisons must satisfy their separately frozen exposure and optimizer-opportunity equalities without silently changing corpus membership or coverage.
cumulative_coverage_dose_overflow_contra.overflow_condition: Full cumulative loss-bearing coverage would exceed any frozen corpus, token, update, or capacity ceiling, or cannot coexist with the frozen comparison equality.

scientific_reporter_analysis_packet.delivery: A separate reporter READ capability supplies the immutable packet; no ambient assignment, estimand, analysis, or label state is permitted.
scientific_reporter_analysis_packet.reporter_input_boundary: The reporter reads frozen typed score records plus this exact packet only and writes reports with no return edge to development, execution, lineage, audit authority, or release.

acceptance_test_and_claim_receipt_contra.ordering_rule: Each phase is required only before the next action it is constructible to guard. No test phase may be required before the implementation or protected artifact needed to execute that phase, and no protected action may produce its own prerequisite.

claim_specific_semantic_requirements.experience_extraction: Requires held-out extraction and native use on fresh homologous actions; training loss, source fit, or verbatim recall is insufficient.
claim_specific_semantic_requirements.Delta_R: Requires powered D-versus-T correct-versus-none evidence with irrelevant and wrong advice reported as selectivity and safety controls; M0 remains diagnostic.
claim_specific_semantic_requirements.Delta_F: Requires powered primary D/T x absent/fixed root-level evidence over the frozen entry-normalized AUC and the allowed non-latent label.
claim_specific_semantic_requirements.Delta_E: Requires powered separately randomized D/T x absent/adaptive root-level evidence over the frozen entry-normalized AUC and the allowed non-latent label.
claim_specific_semantic_requirements.repetition: No repetition-benefit claim is permitted absent its own randomized repetition factor.
claim_specific_semantic_requirements.cadence: K4/K1 is a randomized total-package contrast; standardized-ledger contrasts are descriptive, not mediated effects.
claim_specific_semantic_requirements.rank: Rank contrasts are capacity-by-exposure comparisons under the frozen dose contract.

deferred_exact_contract_boundary.rule: This core names mandatory future frozen artifacts and evidence fields but does not choose implementation, model, tokenizer, data, statistical, capability-wire, resource, execution, GPU, claim, or release bytes. Each remains separately proposal-deliberated and exactly human-authorized before its first permitted use.
